{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABVwqxog", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzg_S2CA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 63, "title": "Add a Node Playground index and migrate the Speech-to-Text demo", "body": "## Problem

The existing Web Speech-to-Text demo is a dedicated application page. As the project adds processor nodes (translation, summarization, etc.), we need a simple, repeatable way to open and try each actual node independently in the browser.

Do not build a model comparison UI or a configurable playground framework. Different model implementations should be separate nodes, each with its own simple test page.

## Expected outcome

Provide a browser-accessible **Node Playground** with a list of available processor nodes. Selecting a node opens its individual test page. Migrate the existing Speech-to-Text demo into this structure, using the actual existing `SpeechToTextNode` and pipeline integration rather than a duplicate test-only recognizer.

Conceptual navigation:

```text
Node Playground
  └─ Speech-to-Text (ReazonSpeech ja-en) → test page
  └─ Future TranslationNode → its own test page
```

Each test page only needs to feed the selected node valid inputs, run it, and show its outputs (plus practical status/errors). Inputs and controls are node-specific; there is no generic model/configuration selector.

## Scope

- Add a small Node Playground index/list with a clickable entry for the currently implemented Speech-to-Text processor.
- Move/reorganize the existing Speech-to-Text Web demo as that node's test page, preserving its current microphone and browser-tab capture choices, provisional/final transcript display, useful diagnostics, and Start/Stop/Cancel behavior.
- Ensure the test page invokes the actual production `SpeechToTextNode` via the existing Node/Port pipeline, with real audio source nodes and transcript sink; do not create a second recognition implementation.
- Keep model and processing policy fixed to the current ReazonSpeech ja-en + Silero/hayamimi node. If future models need independent evaluation, represent them as distinct nodes rather than adding a model switcher.
- Establish only the minimum navigational/page convention needed to add another node test page later; document how a future node is listed and given a simple input/output test page.
- Update README/current Web documentation and any affected relative paths, static asset URLs, service worker isolation, and GitHub Pages deployment/build assumptions.
- Keep Chrome Extension functionality and packaging intact; this Issue does not migrate its UI to the Playground.
- Preserve automated browser testing of the actual speech node and demo flow; adapt paths and selectors where necessary.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- The published Web entry point presents a Node Playground list with a working Speech-to-Text entry.
- Clicking Speech-to-Text opens its test page and it exercises the real existing `SpeechToTextNode` and pipeline.
- Microphone and browser-tab audio still work with existing permissions and source lifecycle.
- Existing provisional/final outputs, empty-final fallback, model loading, Stop/drain, Cancel/release, retry, and diagnostics remain functional.
- The current ASR model is not exposed as a selectable comparison of multiple models.
- Adding a future independent processor requires a list entry and a test page that invokes the actual node, without building a new generic UI framework.
- Node test pages can have different input/output controls appropriate to their node; no forced common configuration/metrics layout.
- All active documentation and links accurately distinguish the Node Playground from the Chrome Extension and pipeline runtime.
- Relevant unit/browser/extension tests pass; deterministic browser tests verify list navigation and actual Speech-to-Text test page behavior.
- No translation/summarization node, node editor, generic plugin SDK, model registry, or unrelated ASR refactor is introduced.

## Required post-merge verification

After GitHub Pages deployment, verify the new published entry point and Speech-to-Text page are served from the merged revision, load successfully, and their required static assets resolve. Record evidence and keep the Issue open until this check is completed.

## Context

- #7: local-first composable processing pipeline vision.
- #57: minimal Node/Port pipeline runtime.
- #59 / PR #60: Web demo already uses the pipeline.
- #61 / PR #62: Chrome Extension already uses the pipeline.

The current demo in `web/index.html` and `web/app.js` is the first concrete test page. This change should reorganize it, not rewrite its ASR implementation.
